content.page_overview: Clinical research questions and proposed randomized trial designs addressing gaps in management of acute coronary syndromes (ACS), spontaneous coronary artery dissection (SCAD), and management of patients with multivessel disease (Section 10).

general_questions.question: Does early implementation of MCS in the management of high-risk ACS patients improve clinical outcomes?
general_questions.proposed_research: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating the benefit of using MCS in high-risk patients.

general_questions.question: Does intracoronary hypothermia reduce infarct size and improve clinical outcomes in STEMI patients undergoing PPCI?
general_questions.proposed_research: Randomized trials to determine whether intracoronary hypothermia reduces myocardial infarct size and whether that translates into clinical improvement.

general_questions.question: What is the optimal antiplatelet strategy in patients presenting with SCAD, including combination and duration of antithrombotic treatment in the acute and post-ACS periods?
general_questions.proposed_research: RCTs evaluating several antiplatelet strategies in patients with SCAD to determine which results in the greatest clinical benefit.

section_10.title: Management of patients with multivessel disease

questions.question: Does complete revascularization of NSTE-ACS with multivessel CAD improve clinical outcomes vs. culprit-only PCI?
questions.proposed_research: Patients with NSTE-ACS and MVD randomized to complete vs. culprit-only PCI.

questions.question: Does management of non-infarct-related CAD with intravascular imaging guidance to identify rupture-prone atherosclerotic plaque improve clinical outcomes?
questions.proposed_research: RCTs testing whether intravascular imaging to guide management of non-infarct-related lesions improves clinical outcomes.

questions.question: Does FFR-guided management improve clinical outcomes vs. standard angiography-guided management in NSTE-ACS?
questions.proposed_research: Patients randomized to FFR-guided management vs. standard angiography-guided management in NSTE-ACS.

questions.question: What is the optimal timing of coronary revascularization (immediate vs. index hospitalization vs. staged) for non-IRA revascularization in STEMI and NSTE-ACS?
questions.proposed_research: Three-arm study comparing immediate, in-hospital, and staged coronary revascularization strategies; patients with MVD randomized to intensive secondary strategies (text truncated).

notes: Multiple proposed RCT designs are suggested to address each question, including head-to-head comparisons of revascularization strategies and imaging- or physiology-guided management approaches.
